files.label: TTL1 (title screen)
files.note: 320x72, 32 colours. ttl2/ttl3/ttl4 are smaller UI panels (288x144, 272x32, 232x64), not more title frames at the same size.

files.label: BIGPIC1 (scenes)
files.note: 3 blocks (112, 115, 120), 304x120 each. Measured 2026-09-02 with the unchanged tools/daa_decode.py; block 112 renders a coherent 32-colour space-wreck scene.

files.label: PIC0 (animated scenes)
files.note: 6-byte sub-frame index, 6 entries. The game dashboard's DAA branch (packages/engine/src/game/loadGame.ts) pushes EVERY distance frame per entry, not just the first — pic0's 6 entries each have exactly 1 distance frame, so 6 frames render here, matching entry count 1:1 by coincidence rather than truncation.

files.label: PIC1 (animated scenes)
files.note: 6-byte sub-frame index, 10 entries, entries hold 1-8 distance frames each; 36 total decoded frames, ALL of which render (verified against tools/subframe_decode.py --amiga, which also reports 36 PNGs). Across pic0..pic3 there are 42 total entries and 112 decoded distance frames (6/36/21/49 PNGs per file).

files.label: PIC2 (animated scenes)
files.note: 6-byte sub-frame index, 9 entries holding 1-5 distance frames each, 21 total decoded frames, all 21 render.

files.label: PIC3 (animated scenes)
files.note: 6-byte sub-frame index, 17 entries holding 1-8 distance frames each, 49 total decoded frames, all 49 render.

files.label: ECL1 (event scripts)
files.note: Amiga Buck's data files (ecl/geo/mon/walldef) are ordinary little-endian DAX, not the big-endian DAA used by the graphics — same split as CoK/DoK Amiga. No Buck ECL dialect verification exists on either platform; this row is an asset listing, not a playability claim.

files.label: GLOBALS (engine globals, not a graphics container)
files.note: Fails the DAA container check (word0=0) — this is state/save-adjacent data, not a picture, despite the .daa extension.

files.label: POINTERS (engine pointer table, not a graphics container)
